description: This file defines a utility class 'Util' within the 'ScssPhp' namespace, providing static methods for range validation, URI encoding, and multibyte string operations, tailored for use in a SCSS processing library.

classes.name: Util
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for range checking, URI encoding, and safe multibyte string operations.

methods.name: checkRange
methods.description: Checks if a value falls within a specified range, considering floating-point errors, and adjusts if necessary.

methods.name: encodeURIComponent
methods.description: Encodes a URI component, similar to JavaScript's encodeURIComponent, handling specific characters.

methods.name: mbChr
methods.description: Creates a multibyte character from a Unicode code point, with compatibility for PHP versions.

methods.name: mbStrlen
methods.description: Returns the length of a string in UTF-8 encoding using mb_strlen or iconv_strlen.

methods.name: mbSubstr
methods.description: Returns a substring of a UTF-8 string, with fallback implementations for mb_substr and iconv_substr.

methods.name: mbStrpos
methods.description: Finds the position of a substring in a UTF-8 string, with fallback implementations.
